```{r}
# install.packages(c("readr","dplyr","janitor"))
library(readr); library(dplyr); library(pacman)
p_load(janitor)

# 1) Forward slashes (recommended on Windows too)
path <- "D:/Dropbox/USD/Dissertation/Collab folder/Data/Dissertation+-+Study+2_September+29,+2025_21.58.csv"


# 1) Skip row 1 so row 2 becomes column names
# 2) Read as character first so we can safely identify/remove the ImportId row
raw <- read_csv(
  path,
  skip = 1,                      # drop row 1
  col_names = TRUE,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 3) Remove the single metadata row (your old row 3) that contains "ImportId"
dat <- raw %>%
  filter(!if_any(everything(), ~ grepl("\\bImportId\\b", .x, ignore.case = TRUE)))

# 4) Clean names and let readr infer types
dat <- dat %>%
  clean_names() %>%              # snake_case names
  type_convert()                 # infer numeric/datetime where appropriate

glimpse(dat)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    version = as.character(version),

    # pull "High/Medium/Low" from the tail
    chartjunk = str_match(version, "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")[,2],
    chartjunk = factor(chartjunk, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE),

    # remove that tail to get the hierarchy label
    hier_raw  = str_remove(version, "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$"),
    hierarchy = recode(hier_raw,
                       "NoHierarchy"          = "none",
                       "FloorplanHierarchy"   = "floorplan",
                       "RoomHierarchy"        = "room",
                       "ImportanceHierarchy"  = "importance"),
    hierarchy = factor(hierarchy)  # unordered
  ) %>%
  select(-hier_raw)

```
